name: Ruta ABDOMINALES Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de abdominales.

instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Take a step back with your right foot, landing on the ball of your foot.
Bend your left knee and lower your body into a Zancada position.
As you lower into the Zancada, simultaneously reach your arms overhead.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior of the Zancada, then regresa a la posición inicial by pushing through your left heel and bringing your right foot forward.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping back with your left foot and bending your right knee.
Continúa alternando lados for the desired number of repetitions.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp a pull-up bar con agarre prono, ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Activa el core and pull your body up towards the bar, bringing your chin above the bar.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your body a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Acuéstate boca arriba with your hands placed behind your head.
Lift your legs del suelo and dobla las rodillas en 90 grados.
Lleva el codo derecho a la rodilla izquierda mientras estiras la pierna derecha.
Regresa a la posición inicial and repite el movimiento al otro lado, llevando el codo izquierdo a la rodilla derecha mientras estiras la pierna izquierda.
Continúa alternando lados in a pedaling motion for the desired number of repetitions.
Start by gripping a vertical pole with both hands, palms facing each other, and arms fully extended.
Activa el core and lift your legs del suelo, manteniéndolas estiradas.
Using your core and upper body strength, raise your legs until they are paralelo al suelo.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your legs a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your knees bent.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza or across your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the bench, inclinándote hacia adelante towards your knees.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then baja lentamente el torso a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Acuéstate boca arriba con las rodillas dobladas and los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Coloca las manos detrás de la cabeza con los codos hacia afuera.
Contrayendo los abdominales, levanta lentamente el torso del suelo, inclinándote hacia adelante hasta que tu torso esté en un ángulo de 45 grados.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then baja lentamente el torso a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Ruta PIERNAS Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de piernas.

instructions: Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Take a step forward with one foot and place it about two feet in front of the other foot.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is paralelo al suelo, and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Pausa un momento, then push through your front heel to regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch legs and repeat.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Swing your arms back for momentum.
Jump forward explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next jump.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Empieza a cuatro patas with your manos bajo los hombros and your rodillas bajo las caderas.
Extiende una pierna hacia atrás, manteniendo la rodilla doblada.
Baja lentamente la cadera al suelo, sintiendo el estiramiento en los cuádriceps.
Mantén la posición 20-30 segundos.
Cambia de pierna and repite el estiramiento al otro lado.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Bend your knees slightly and jump backwards, pushing off with both feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Slowly lower your body by bending your knees and leaning back, keeping your torso upright.
Continue lowering until your thighs are paralelo al suelo or as far as you can comfortably go.
Pausa un momento, then push through your heels to regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Stand facing away from a suspension trainer with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one leg forward and place the top of your foot in the foot cradle of the suspension trainer.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down into a Zancada position, keeping your chest up and your knee in line with your toes.
Push through your heel to regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch legs.

name: Ruta GEMELOS Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de gemelos.

exercises.name_es: Box salto down with one pierna stabilization
instructions: Stand in front of a box or platform with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and jump onto the box, landing softly with one foot on the box and the other foot hanging off the edge.
Stabilize yourself on the box with the foot that is on it, while keeping the other foot del suelo.
Hold this position for a few seconds, engaging your calf muscles to maintain balance.
Slowly step down with the foot that is on the box, returning to the starting position.
Repeat the exercise with the other leg.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a stable surface for support, such as a wall or a bar.
Lift one leg del suelo, keeping your knee slightly bent.
Raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch legs.
Stand facing a wall or sturdy object, about an arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall or object at shoulder height.
Step back with one foot, keeping your heel flat on the ground.
Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight.
You should feel a stretch in your calf muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other leg.
Stand with your toes on an elevated surface, such as a step or block.
Place your hands on a stable support, such as a wall or railing, for balance.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your heels a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Sit on the edge of a chair or bench with your los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you, keeping your heel on the ground.
Lean forward slightly, feeling a stretch in your calf muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Cambia de pierna and repeat the stretch.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a wall or stable surface for balance.
Slowly raise your heels del suelo, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your heels a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Desafío de ESPALDA
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de espalda.

instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm straight out in front of you and place your palm against the wall.
Activa el core and lean your body forward, keeping your arm straight and your back flat.
Slowly push against the wall with your palm, activating your lat muscles.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then release and repeat with the other arm.
Start by hanging from a vertical bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Activa el core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Al subir, lean back slightly and bring your elbows towards your sides.
Continue pulling until your chest reaches the bar and your elbows are fully bent.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower yourself a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, paralelo al suelo.
Cross your arms in front of your body, with your right arm over your left arm.
Interlock your fingers and rotate your palms away from your body.
Slowly raise your arms up and away from your body, feeling a stretch in your back and chest.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the opposite side.
Position yourself under a bar or a sturdy horizontal surface that is at chest height.
Grab the bar or surface con agarre prono, ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Pull your chest towards the bar or surface by juntando las escápulas and bending your elbows.
Sigue subiendo hasta que la barbilla pase la barra or surface.
Lower yourself a la posición inicial with control.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Hang from a pull-up bar with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and your arms fully extended.
Activa el core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Sigue subiendo hasta que la barbilla pase la barra.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your body a la posición inicial with control.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Activa el core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and bringing your chest towards the bar.
Pause en la parte superior of the movement, then slowly lower your body a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Dominio de PECHO
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de pecho.

instructions: Start in a high Plancha position with your hands ligeramente más ancho que los hombros and your feet together.
Activa el core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pausa un momento when your chest is just above the ground, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Position yourself on parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Baja doblando los codos until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Empieza en posición de flexión with your hands ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Extiende un brazo hacia el lado, paralelo al suelo.
Baja doblando los codos, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Empuja de vuelta al inicio.
Repite en el otro lado, extendiendo el brazo opuesto al lado.
Continúa alternando lados for the desired number of repetitions.
Start by lying flat on your back on a mat or bench.
Extiende los brazos hacia los lados, perpendicular to your body.
Activa el core and lift both legs del suelo, keeping them together and straight.
Slowly lower your legs to one side, aiming to touch the ground with your feet while maintaining control.
Pausa un momento, then use your core to lift your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time lowering your legs to the opposite side.
Continúa alternando lados for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name_es: Wide-grip chest fondo on high parallel bars
instructions: Position yourself on the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Lean forward slightly and lower your body by bending your elbows until your chest is just above the bars.
Pausa un momento, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start in a high Plancha position with your manos bajo los hombros and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you lower, rotate your body to the left, extending your left arm straight out to the side.
Empuja de vuelta al inicio, while rotating your body to the center.
Repeat the push-up, this time rotating your body to the right and extending your right arm out to the side.
Continúa alternando lados with each repetition.

name: Ruta GLÚTEOS Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de glúteos.

instructions: Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas estiradas.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left knee.
Place your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently twist your torso to the right.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
Lie on your back with your los pies apoyados en el suelo and your knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and lift your hips del suelo until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your hips a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead.
Activa el core and lift your chest and legs del suelo simultaneously.
Kick your legs up and down in a fluttering motion, as if you were swimming.
Continue kicking for the desired number of repetitions.
Lower your chest and legs a la posición inicial.
Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for support.
Slowly lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands and extending your legs behind you.
Keep your back straight and engage your glutes as you push your hips back and up towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few seconds, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
Slowly regresa a la posición inicial by bending your knees and lowering your hips back down.
Repite las veces necesarias.

exercises.name_es: Glute puente two legs on bench (male)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your back against it and your los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Place your hands on the bench beside your hips for support.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then lift your hips off the bench until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your hips a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Jump up explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
While in mid-air, quickly bring your feet together.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately drop back into a squat position.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Dominio de CARDIO
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de cardio.

instructions: Empieza a cuatro patas with your manos bajo los hombros and your rodillas bajo las caderas.
Lift your knees slightly del suelo, keeping your back flat and el core activo.
Move your right hand and left foot forward simultaneously, followed by your left hand and right foot.
Continue crawling forward, alternating your hand and foot movements.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your core tight throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired distance or time.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right knee up towards your chest as high as you can while balancing on your left leg.
Step forward with your right foot and lower your body into a Zancada position, bending both knees to a 90-degree angle.
Push off with your right foot and bring your left knee up towards your chest.
Step forward with your left foot and lower your body into a Zancada position.
Continue alternating legs and lunging forward, keeping el core activo and maintaining a steady pace.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Step forward with your right foot, bending your knee and lowering your body into a Zancada position.
Push off with your right foot and step back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left foot, alternating legs with each step.
Continue stepping back and forth, maintaining a steady pace.
Repeat for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
Start by standing upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Activa el core and keep your upper body relaxed.
Begin jogging in place, lifting your knees up towards your chest and landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Maintain a steady pace and continue jogging for the desired duration or distance.
Remember to breathe deeply and maintain good posture throughout the exercise.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros.
Bend your knees slightly and keep your back straight.
Jump to the right, landing on your right foot while swinging your left leg behind your right leg.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot while swinging your right leg behind your left leg.
Continue alternating jumps from side to side, mimicking a skiing motion.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start in a high Plancha position with your manos bajo los hombros and your body in a straight line.
Activa el core and bring your right knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring your left knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, keeping your hips low and el core activo.
Maintain a steady pace and breathe evenly throughout the exercise.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Ruta ESPALDA ALTA Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de espalda alta.

instructions: Start by hanging from a bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Activa el core and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Continue to lift your legs up and over your head, allowing your body to pass through the arms.
Once your legs are fully extended over your head, begin to lower them back down towards the starting position.
As you lower your legs, allow your body to pass back through the arms until you are hanging with your arms fully extended again.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, paralelo al suelo.
Interlace your fingers and rotate your palms away from your body.
Slowly raise your arms overhead, manteniéndolas estiradas and parallel to each other.
As you raise your arms, squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release and repeat.
Cuelga de una barra de dominadas con agarre prono, hands ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Activa el core and lleva las escápulas hacia abajo y atrás.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Slowly lift your legs up, manteniéndolas estiradas, until your body is paralelo al suelo.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then baja las piernas lentamente a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Set up a bench at a height that allows your body to hang freely underneath it.
Lie face up on the ground with your head towards the bench.
Reach up and grab the bench con agarre prono, ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Position your body so that your heels are on the ground and your arms are fully extended.
Activa el core and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull your chest up towards the bench.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior of the movement, then slowly lower your body a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

exercises.name_es: Bodyweight standing one brazo remo (with towel)
instructions: Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros, knees slightly bent, and hold a towel with one hand.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and el core activo.
Pull the towel towards your chest, juntando las escápulas.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower the towel back to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch to the other arm.
Set up a suspension trainer at an appropriate height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handles con agarre prono, palms facing each other.
Lean back, keeping your body straight and your heels on the ground.
Pull your chest towards the handles, juntando las escápulas.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Ruta TRÍCEPS Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de tríceps.

instructions: Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, paralelo al suelo.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your upper arms close to your sides.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet forward, sliding your butt off the bench, and straighten your arms.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start in a high Plancha position with your hands close together, forming a diamond shape with your thumbs and index fingers.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to toe, engaging your core and glutes.
Lower your chest towards the diamond shape formed by your hands, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Place your hands on an elevated surface, such as a bench or step, ligeramente más ancho que los hombros.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, with your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards the elevated surface by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Start by getting on your hands and knees, with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees hip-width apart.
Lower your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Pausa un momento when your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Kneel down on the ground with your knees hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you, shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs straight behind you, balancing on your toes and hands, forming a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your upper body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Dominio de BÍCEPS
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de bíceps.

instructions: Sit on a bench with your legs spread apart and your los pies apoyados en el suelo.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
With your palm facing up, curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps en la parte superior of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch arms.
Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing towards you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Activa el core and pull yourself up towards the bar, focusing on using your biceps to lift your body.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower yourself a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Activa el core and pull yourself up by bending your elbows, bringing your chest towards the bar.
Pause en la parte superior of the movement, then slowly lower yourself a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head supported by your arm.
Hold your upper arm against your side and bend your elbow to curl your forearm towards your shoulder.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your forearm a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Dominio de ADDUCTORS
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de adductors.

instructions: Sit on the floor con las piernas estiradas.
Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together, allowing your knees to fall out to the sides.
Hold onto your ankles or feet with your hands.
Sit up tall and lengthen your spine.
Gently press your knees down towards the floor, feeling a stretch in your inner thighs.
Hold this position for a few breaths.
To release, slowly bring your knees back up and extend your legs.
Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Engage your adductors and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your leg a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.
Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Activa el core and lift your hips del suelo, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While maintaining the side Plancha position, lift your top leg towards the ceiling, keeping it straight.
Slowly lower your leg a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.

name: Dominio de PIERNAS (POSTERIOR)
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de piernas (posterior).

instructions: Start in a Zancada position with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Place your hands on the ground on either side of your right foot.
Lower your left knee to the ground and extend your right leg, keeping your right foot flat on the ground.
Rotate your torso to the right, reaching your right arm up towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then regresa a la posición inicial.
Switch sides and repeat the stretch with your left foot forward.

exercises.name_es: Self assisted inverse pierna curl (on floor)
instructions: Acuéstate boca arriba with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and place your los pies apoyados en el suelo, hip-width apart.
Lift your hips del suelo, engaging your glutes and hamstrings.
Slowly curl your legs towards your glutes, keeping your hips lifted.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
Lower your hips back down to the ground.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Lie face down on a leg curl machine with your legs extended and your ankles hooked under the padded lever.
Place your hands on the side handles of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs upward as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position while inhaling.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot del suelo, bending your knee.
Slowly curl your right heel towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstring.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your right foot a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch legs.
Siéntate en el suelo with your legs extended in a wide angle.
Flex your feet and engage your quadriceps.
Place your hands on the ground behind you for support.
Manteniendo la espalda recta, lean forward from your hips.
Continue leaning forward until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold this position for a few breaths.
Slowly release the stretch and regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

exercises.name_es: Inverse pierna curl (on dominada cable machine)
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle straps are at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs extended and the ankle straps attached to your feet.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Bend your knees and curl your legs towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstrings.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior of the movement, then baja las piernas lentamente back to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Desafío de LUMBARES
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de lumbares.

instructions: Lie flat on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and levanta lentamente el torso del suelo, curling your back upwards.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then baja lentamente el torso a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Adjust the hyperextension bench so that your upper thighs are resting on the pad and your feet are secured.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Lower your upper body towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then raise your upper body back up until it is in line with your legs.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Siéntate en el suelo con las piernas estiradas.
Place your hands on the ground behind you, fingers pointing towards your body.
Activa el core and slowly lean back, keeping your back straight.
Continue leaning back until you feel a stretch in your spine.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your knees slightly bent.
Place your hands on your hips or let them hang by your sides.
Activa el core muscles and tilt your pelvis forward, pushing your lower back towards the wall behind you.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then release and regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Adjust the hyperextension bench so that your hips are resting comfortably on the pad and your feet are secured.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Slowly lower your upper body towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then raise your upper body back up until it is in line with your legs.
Repite las veces necesarias.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your arms extended out to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with both hands, keeping your legs straight.
Pausa un momento en la parte inferior, then slowly regresa a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Ruta FOREARMS Nivel 1
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de forearms.

instructions: Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Make a fist with both hands.
Rotate your wrists in a circular motion, keeping your arms still.
Continue the wrist circles for the desired number of repetitions.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your arms extended in front of you.
Extend your right arm out to the side, paralelo al suelo, with your palm facing down.
With your left hand, grab your right hand and gently pull it towards your body, feeling a stretch in your right forearm.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repite en el otro lado.
Empieza en posición de flexión with your manos bajo los hombros and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body down towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Once your elbows are at a 90-degree angle, lower your forearms to the ground, keeping your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Pausa un momento, then push through your palms to lift your forearms back up to the starting position.
Repite las veces necesarias.

name: Desafío de ABDUCTORS
description: Sigue el camino para perfeccionar tu técnica de abductors.

instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Activa el core and lift your hips del suelo, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While keeping el core activo, lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then lower your leg back down.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.
Párate con los pies al ancho de los hombros and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight to one leg and lift the opposite leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your leg a la posición inicial.
Repite en el otro lado.
Continúa alternando lados for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Activa el core and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pausa un momento en la parte superior, then slowly lower your leg a la posición inicial.
Repite las veces necesarias, then switch sides.
